```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

To install the `snp.slicer` package, you can use the following command:

install.packages(
    'snp.slicer', 
    repos = c('https://plasmogenepi.r-universe.dev', 'https://cloud.r-project.org')
)
